review_candidates.description: Ziegler Energy Solutions has an opening for an Engineering Manager with deep expertise in electrical power systems to lead technical design, integration, and engineering execution across distributed energy and infrastructure projects. Working closely with senior design, marketing, agencies, and suppliers, you’ll help maintain a distinctive and consistent visual identity. The role combines strong design craft with motion, storytelling, and experimentation with emerging creative technologies. Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and a solid understanding of digital and print production processes. Excellent eye for typography, composition, visual hierarchy, layout, and consistent brand application. Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain high creative standards while working across multiple projects and deadlines. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with marketing teams, agencies, suppliers, and senior stakeholders.
